error.invalid_notify_service: Use the notify service name only, such as phones_group.

user.title: Night Watchman
user.description: Rounds run from the first time through the last time. A round is skipped when any activity device changed during the quiet period. On/off is not activity. Only a recent change is.

doors_to_lock.name: Doors to Lock
doors_to_lock.description: A lock runs only when it is unlocked and the contact beside it is closed. An open contact is reported and left unlocked. Do not add the garage overhead door.

data_description.activity_lights: A recent on or off change skips the round. A new light is ignored until you add it here.
data_description.activity_motion: A recent motion change skips the round, including indoor cameras if you add them.
data_description.activity_doors: A recent open or close skips the round. This does not lock or close the door.
data_description.include_activity_lights: Turns off every monitored light when a round runs.
data_description.keep_on_lights: Stays on even when the checkbox above is selected. Use this for bedrooms and lamps.
data_description.turn_off_entities: Extra lights or switches to turn off, such as a coffee maker or 3D printer. Do not add strips that should stay on.
data_description.lock_entity_1: Locked only if this lock is unlocked and the contact below is closed.
data_description.contact_entity_1: Do not use the garage overhead door.
data_description.notify_service: Service under Developer Tools, for example phones_group.

user.title: Lock if the door is closed
user.description: The lock is turned only when the contact is closed. An open contact is reported and left unlocked.

reconfigure.title: Lock if the door is closed

user.title: Report if open
user.description: Included in the phone message when open. Nothing is closed or locked.
